fix_commit_message:
Range check the column index on the sqlite3_preupdate_old() interface and return SQLITE_MISUSE if too large. [forum:/forumpost/b617e497287235d0|Forum post b617e49728].

FossilOrigin-Name: 6a5701e6c7be25cba93e55438f950966e1dacb32eb2b23a8acc8ac53da6f0a85
agent_reasoning: The bug-introducing commit refactored sqlite3_preupdate_old() to call sqlite3TableColumnToStorage(), a helper that only debug-asserts (rather than runtime-checks) that its column index argument is within bounds. This left a public API entry point (invoked from user-registered pre-update hooks with an arbitrary caller-supplied index) without a corresponding runtime bounds check, enabling an out-of-bounds read in release builds. The fix adds the missing runtime check (iIdx >= p->pTab->nCol) at the call site, returning SQLITE_MISUSE_BKPT, mirroring the exact patch from the real fix commit. This is the minimal, scoped edit matching the fix diff.
